history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — keep-or-drop decision needed. This is a CHRISTIAN (Presbyterian) church, not a Hindu temple. 'Presbyterian Church, Lawngtlai' is a GENERIC name matching several documented Mizoram Presbyterian Church (Synod) congregations in Lawngtlai town: the Mizoram Presbyterian Church at Bazar Veng, Lawngtlai-II, below Dokulha Hall (mapcarta, 22.53135, 92.89763 — used as the best-supported referent, confirmed by reverse-geocode to Dokulha Hall); a 'Presbyterian Church' in Chandmary, Lawngtlai (Justdial, 4.3 rating); 'Lawngtlai Bethel Presbyterian Church' (indiainfo); 'Presbyterian Church, Lawngtlai AOC Veng' (indiainfo); and 'Vengthlang Presbyterian Church' (toptouristplaces). The intended congregation is ambiguous — verify locally which one the CSV row means. The Synod's Lawngtlai presence is long-standing: the Synod Bookroom Lawngtlai Branch was established in 1986 and a new building inaugurated on 6 April 2016. CSV town 'Lawngtlai' is correct. Cross-reference: seq 734 ('Mizo Synod Church') very likely refers to the same set of congregations and is a probable duplicate.

name: Presbyterian Church, Lawngtlai
town_description: Lawngtlai is the district headquarters of Lawngtlai district in southern Mizoram, home to the Lai (Pawi) people. Per the 2011 census the district is 54.19% Christian (mostly Baptist, Presbyterian and indigenous denominations) and 43.72% Buddhist, reflecting the Chakma-majority Chawngte block; Hinduism is 1.41%. Presbyterian congregations of the Mizoram Synod are among the town's main places of worship.

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport (Aizawl), the nearest airport; Lawngtlai is roughly a 5-6 hour drive from Aizawl via Lunglei (verify distance).
travel.railway: No railway station in Lawngtlai; nearest railhead not reliably published (verify) — candidates include Bairabi (Mizoram) and Silchar (Assam).
travel.road: Lawngtlai is connected by road to Aizawl via Lunglei and to Saiha and Chawngte by district roads; buses and shared taxis run from Aizawl and Lunglei (verify).

visitor_information.opening_hours: Sunday services are the norm for Presbyterian churches; confirm service timings locally.
